recipients.reason: Send failed: getSession is not a function

root_cause: whatsapp-client.js does not export getSession in module.exports. media-dispatch.js destructures { getSession } from require('./whatsapp-client'), evaluating getSession as undefined at call time.
secondary_defect: outreach.js line 233 sets status=CASE WHEN status='cancel_requested' THEN 'cancelled' ELSE 'completed' END unconditionally. outreach_jobs_status_check constraint also lacked 'failed' and 'completed_with_errors' enums.
